title: Scram and restart
brief: Bring the reactor to a steady power and hold it. Then scram it and watch the period settle. Reset the trip and restart.

goals.text: Hold the power between 1 % and 50 % of the power-high setpoint for 10 minutes

goals.source: rod position 0 is fully inserted (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, conventions)

goals.text: Watch the period settle near -80 s
goals.source: Keepin, Physics of Nuclear Kinetics (1965): after a scram from steady power the period settles at about -80 s, set by the longest-lived delayed-neutron group (half-life about 55 s)

goals.text: Reset the trip and raise the power above 1 % of the power-high setpoint again

hints: The steady hold lets the delayed-neutron precursors reach equilibrium. Without it, the period after the scram does not settle near -80 s.
The negative period does not depend on how much rod worth went in.
A manual scram latches a trip. Reset it before you withdraw the rods.
